text:
vik: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: APAC GPU constraints. Two asks: 1) what's our short-term contingency if A100 SKUs don't arrive on schedule, and 2) what telemetry will trigger automatic cross-region bursting?
maya: Short-term contingency = mix of strategies: accelerate reserved slots in partner colo in SG, enable mixed-SKU burst pools (V100/T4) for low-SLO traffic, and prioritize enterprise traffic for any remaining A100s. We're expecting partial A100 shipments starting mid-Q3 but can't fully count on it.
dinesh: Telemetry-wise, autoscaler watches a combined metric: region_available_gpus, queue_latency_p50/p95, and reserved_capacity_utilization. We have threshold gates: if p95 request latency > 750ms AND region_available_gpus < 10% for 10m, autoscaler will evaluate cross-region burst.
reza: To add: bursting will be opt-in per-customer unless they're on "latency-tolerant" tier. Default policy aims to keep requests in-region for privacy-sensitive teams. We'll surface a per-project toggle in the console.
anya: For product teams considering regional isolation: we can provision short-term dedicated cushions (212weeks) via reserved capacity. Ping me with customer names and SLA class.
ops-oncall: Implementation note: when cross-region burst happens, we add a header X-Redwood-Fallback:region=target,model=variant so SDKs/clients can log and surface to users. Also we emit a syslog event and a billing-preview event.
vik: Nice. How does this affect session continuity if the target model is a different quant/arch?
dinesh: If arch-compatible (same family + compatible tokenizer), we attempt KV cache reuse. If not compatible, we gracefully checkpoint and restart the session on the target with a short "resuming on fallback" message. We avoid mid-token migration; in-flight requests finish on origin if possible.
maya: Ops action: procurement team will post an updated ETA doc and a short decision tree for teams (reserve, accept mixed-SKU burst, or force cross-region) by COB Wednesday.
reza: Cost impact Q: cross-region egress + premium instances. Ballpark: 1015% more on per-token costs for cross-region+mixed-SKU retries, higher for high throughput. We'll add a per-route cost-estimator prototype to Console next week.
vik: Good. Can we have a test harness so product teams can simulate a burst failover? I want to run two customer scenarios.
ops-oncall: Yes, we have a smoke harness. We'll spin up a canary simulating regional depletion and a mixed-SKU fallback. Need list of routes and sample traffic shapes.
anya: I'll collect routes today and share. Also we'll draft a short customer notification template for any forced re-routing.
infra-bot: policy 2160-apac-fallbacks deployed to canary cluster (5 nodes); monitor url: https://infracanary.local/2160 :eyes:
vik: Thanks all. Please post the procurement ETA link and the test harness instructions in #announcements so I can loop in the customers.
maya: Will do, and will pin the runbook. :white_check_mark:
